description: This file contains private definitions, structures, macros, and register mappings for the Intel e1000 Ethernet driver, including register addresses, descriptor structures, and configuration enums.

classes.name: e1000_tx
classes.description: Legacy transmit descriptor structure for the e1000 Ethernet driver.

classes.name: e1000_rx
classes.description: Legacy receive descriptor structure for the e1000 Ethernet driver.

classes.name: e1000_dev
classes.description: Device structure representing the e1000 Ethernet hardware, including register mappings, MAC address, buffers, and optional PTP clock.

classes.name: e1000_config
classes.description: Configuration structure containing a function pointer for device-specific configuration.

methods.name: e1000_reg_to_string
methods.description: Converts register enum values to their string representations.

methods.name: iow32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a device register.

methods.name: ior32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a device register.
